from.place: Step 2 of the proof ('effectivity ... By [lem-galois-glue] the P_i glue to a Y-scheme P'), realized by Stacks 02W3: its affine-base proof invokes Topologies 022E to refine the singleton fpqc cover by finitely many affine opens

title: A singleton fpqc covering of an affine scheme has a finite affine-open refinement
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism such that the one-member family $\{f:X\to S\}$ is an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Then there are an integer $m\ge0$, affine open subschemes $X_j\subseteq X$ for $j=1,\dots,m$, their coproduct $X'=\coprod_{j=1}^mX_j$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], and the morphisms $h:X'\to X$ induced by the open inclusions and $g=f\circ h:X'\to S$, such that $X'$ is affine, $g$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and hence $\{g:X'\to S\}$ is an fpqc covering. The map $h$ is a morphism over $S$.
